pairs.subject: agent-chaining
pairs.evidence: src/app/api/executions/[id]/stream/route.ts:13 This context only lists, filters, cancels and relays the output of individual executions run by an external orchestrator, and never wires, fires, guards or ledgers agent-to-agent handoffs. A search of src/components/dashboard and src/app/api/executions found 0 hits for chainId, chain_id, chainDepth, stopReason, stop_reason, parentExecutionId and runCondition, so the subject's event-wired-chain precondition does not hold here.

techniques.evidence: src/app/api/executions/[id]/stream/route.ts:13 The only server code here is a read-only SSE relay of one execution's output. No drawn edge is turned into subscription rows.
